question: Do equity markets systematically precede changes in Fiscal V2 and Funding V2, and is the apparent reverse/contrarian relationship robust enough to explain why these overlays correlate with later returns without implying direct causal leadership?

overlays.analysis_transform: first_difference_if_needed_by_ADF; otherwise level and difference both reported

bidirectional_granger.overlay_series: stationary transform selected mechanically by ADF: level if p<0.05 else first difference
bidirectional_granger.multiple_testing: Holm correction separately within each direction across overlays/assets/lags
bidirectional_granger.interpretation: predictive precedence only, never structural causality

common_driver_regression.inference: joint F test for SPY lags with HAC/Newey-West covariance, maxlags=3

component_attribution.question: Which overlay component, if any, carries market-to-overlay precedence?
component_attribution.multiple_testing: Holm correction across fixed component family

pandemic_exclusion.purpose: check whether the result is only a pandemic artifact

lead_lag_asymmetry.purpose: separate reactive/contrarian behavior from true leading behavior

decision_rule: No production PASS/FAIL gate. Classify the mechanism as MARKET_PRECEDENCE_SUPPORTED, MIXED_OR_REGIME_DEPENDENT, or NO_REVERSE_PRECEDENCE based on the predeclared diagnostics; production implication is always NONE.
guardrail: This research cannot promote, demote, invert, reweight, or retune Fiscal V2 or Funding V2. Any later methodology change requires a separately versioned candidate and frozen gate.
